module.title: Days 1–10 | Competition Mastery Module
module.description: Production candidate: authored topic-driven National Mathematics Championship curriculum.

lessons.title: Advanced number theory foundations
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of advanced number theory foundations and apply it accurately to unfamiliar questions.
lessons.core_teaching_content: Championship mathematics emphasises structure, proof intuition and non-routine reasoning. Look for invariants, parity, symmetry, factorisation, counting structure and useful bounds before performing long calculations. A solution should be checked against the original conditions, including edge cases. When a result seems plausible, verify it independently because contest distractors often arise from a single hidden assumption or arithmetic shortcut. In this lesson, focus specifically on advanced number theory foundations. Identify the defining concepts, the distinctions that commonly cause mistakes, and the evidence or procedure needed to justify an answer. Practise moving from recognition to application: first identify what the question is testing, then select a method, perform the reasoning carefully, and verify the result against the wording and constraints. Keep an error log that records the misconception or decision error, not just the correct answer.
examples: A National Mathematics Championship question on advanced number theory foundations should be solved by identifying the key clue, applying the relevant principle, and checking the option against all stated conditions.
Create a new advanced number theory foundations scenario with one tempting distractor. Explain why the correct response is supported and why the distractor fails.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused National Mathematics Championship activity on advanced number theory foundations. Build a small table, diagram, worked example, speaking sample, writing sample or practice set as appropriate to the subject, then explain the reasoning behind the result.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on advanced number theory foundations: model the first, prompt the second, and require independent justification on the third. Ask the learner to identify the exact clue, rule or evidence used before confirming the answer.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar questions on advanced number theory foundations without viewing the answer.
Create one new example and solve it using the lesson method.
Review one distractor or error and explain why it is wrong.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item National Mathematics Championship checkpoint focused on advanced number theory foundations. Target at least six correct and justify every uncertain response.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished National Mathematics Championship task demonstrating advanced number theory foundations and record the reasoning, evidence or performance criteria used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach the learner toward evidence-based reasoning and precise terminology. Ask for the method before giving correction, and turn each error into a reusable rule or practice target. This lesson remains suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one mistake pattern and one concrete action for improving advanced number theory foundations in the next practice session.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Practice → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
